item.title: FREE TOGETHER public event in Montclair on October 24 — Sat Oct 24, 10:00 AM — Church Street
item.description: Four local community organizations invite you to our public connection event on October 24, 10am–2pm, outdoors on Church Street in Montclair Center. We’re asking how we can all be FREE TOGETHER? – supporting one another in freedom, giving freely and joyfully to one another in our community, and expressing our needs freely and comfortably? Let’s open our imaginations – for a future where we have the freedom that comes from meeting one another’s needs within our community. Stop by for an interactive brainstorming and live art experience. Come meet local organizations already building community support systems! Learn about mutuality and mutual aid opportunities in our local area. We’ll listen to your ideas about community giving and receiving. Fun activities for adults and children will be offered. item.title: Gather and Ground - A Yoga Mini Retreat for Menopause — Sat Oct 24, 2:00 PM — Yoga Mechanics
item.description: Join us on Saturday, October 24th 2-5pm for Gather and Ground – A Yoga Mini Retreat for Menopause. All levels of yoga experience are welcome. Designed for women navigating perimenopause, menopause and beyond, this workshop offers: ⁠Strength & Balance Flow – an active practice focused on maintaining strength, stability and balance as our bodies change Gentle Flow & Mobility – slower movement designed to support mobility, release tension and help you feel more comfortable in your body Restorative Yoga & Deep Rest – a deeply supportive practice to downshift the nervous system and encourage rest and recovery. Menopause is not one experience, and there is no single “right” way to move through it. Come learn, move, rest, ask questions and explore what supports your body now. You’ll leave with lovingly prepared, homemade snacks, handouts summarizing the key points of our time together, and a supportive community. The first 10 sign-ups get 10% off: Select “Early Bird” under ticket options

item.title: In-Person and Live Stream Service — Sun Nov 1, 10:00 AM — Sanctuary
item.description:
Sunday worship takes place at 10am in person at 176 Cooper Avenue in Montclair or livestreamed on our YouTube channel: Sunday Worship Livestream Union Congregational Church is located in Montclair, New Jersey, at 176 Cooper Avenue (nearest major cross streets are Grove Street and Valley Road). There is street parking on Cooper Avenue. We have a small parking lot for seniors and those with limited mobility reached through a driveway to the left of the church. There are two accessible spots and a ramp on the left side of the building. Additional parking is available on neighboring streets. Please note that Cooper Avenue runs one way on Sundays, so it is best to enter from Valley Road or Northview Avenue. Enter the church through the main Sanctuary doors under the tower or through the accessible entrance through the Assembly Room at the top of the ramp on the left side of the church. Join Us Here Click here for the Sunday Worship Bulletin
Source: Union Congregational Church

item.title: Astrology 101: What's Your Sign? — Thu Dec 10, 6:00 PM — Nutley - Stockton Room
item.description:
Thursday, December 10, 2026 from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM.
No registration required!
Let's talk astrology! This program will provide a basic overview of Western astrology, including the twelve zodiac signs, the four elements and three modalities, the ten traditional planets, and the five major aspects.
This program is a lecture-style PowerPoint presentation with Q&A woven throughout. The focus here is not on "sun sign astrology" (analyzing personalities based simply on the twelve zodiac signs), but rather on gaining a bird's eye view of the larger astrological system, of which sun signs are just one part.
